entities.summary: Burmese, a notable figure in the history of Laos, associated with Kingdom of Lan Xang (1548–1571). Preceded by Golden Age of Setthathirath and Phra Bang Buddha image brought from the Khmer court to Luang Prabang. Their legacy influenced Souligna Vongsa and Fragmentation.
